definitions.explanation: Doing something by one's own hand or action.
Acting without being forced or asked.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{自|みずか}ら⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：01449_setsumei⟧。
{自|みずか}ら⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}った→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自|みずか}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦べきだ→べき：10016_beki⟧。
examples.english: You should solve the problem through your own actions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{自|みずか}ら⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：03562_happyou⟧。
examples.english: The prime minister announced it personally.
I made it with my own hands.

examples.japanese: {自|みずか}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：03571_handan⟧。
examples.english: I'll judge based on my own responsibility.

examples.japanese: {自|みずか}ら⟦{志願|しがん}した→志願する：11342_shigansuru⟧。
examples.english: I volunteered of my own accord.

examples.japanese: {自|みずか}ら⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：02498_sanka⟧。
{自|みずか}ら⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}た→申し出る：10465_moushideru⟧。
{自|みずか}ら⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's a path I chose voluntarily.

notes:
{自|みずか}ら functions as both an adverb (personally, voluntarily) and a pronoun (oneself).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {自|みずか}ら⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (voluntarily, proactively)
- {自|みずか}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (with one's own hands)
- {自|みずか}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意思|いし}→意思：12742_ishi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (of one's own will)
- {自|みずか}ら⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to act personally)
When used as a pronoun, {自|みずか}ら takes the possessive particle ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {自|みずか}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧ (one's own responsibility).

Register: Formal/literary. More common in written Japanese and formal speech. ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ is the casual equivalent.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自|みずか}ら vs. ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧ is the common everyday word for "oneself"; {自|みずか}ら emphasizes personal initiative or action and is more formal/literary.
- {自|みずか}ら vs. {自|みずか}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {自|みずか}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ functions as a possessive ("one's own").
